summary: Fortuna Mining Corp. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its unaudited condensed interim consolidated financial statements and MD&A for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, plus CEO/CFO certifications and a November 4, 2026 news release. Results show third-quarter sales of $293.4 million versus $251.4 million, net income of $52.3 million ($0.16 per share) versus $128.2 million, and a $52.7 million impairment reversal. No transaction, shareholder solicitation, or structural event is disclosed; this is a routine quarterly reporting package with no deal terms to arbitrage.
